compiled_state.title: Create plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh asserting AWS account ID matches expected
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When this story is complete, `aws sts get-caller-identity` exits 0 and returns the expected account ID 820258254566.

## TDD Test Approach
Given a stub `aws` binary on PATH returning `{"Account":"820258254566",...}` and config key review_telemetry.aws_account_id=820258254566; When `bash plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh` is invoked; Then the script exits 0 and confirms account matched. Additional cases: (a) wrong account → exits 1 with expected/actual diff; (b) aws auth failure → exits non-zero surfacing error; (c) aws absent from PATH → exits non-zero with clear "aws CLI not found" message; (d) config key present → script reads from config (not hardcoded default only).

## Implementation Notes
1. Read expected account from `.claude/dso-config.conf` key `review_telemetry.aws_account_id` (default 820258254566 when absent)
2. Invoke `aws sts get-caller-identity --output json`
3. Parse Account field: `python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d["Account"])'`
4. Exit 0 when Account matches; print `expected=<exp> actual=<act>` to stderr and exit 1 otherwise
5. Handle aws CLI absent from PATH: check with `command -v aws` and exit non-zero with clear message
6. Handle python3 absent from PATH: check with `command -v python3` and exit non-zero with clear message
7. Set executable bit immediately after creation (chmod +x)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Script exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] ShellCheck passes (no warnings)
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] python3 availability is checked in the script with a clear error on absence
  Verify: grep -q 'command -v python3' plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] aws CLI availability is checked with a clear error on absence
  Verify: grep -q 'command -v aws' plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] Behavioral test file exists
  Verify: test -f tests/scripts/test-verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] Happy-path test: stub aws returning account 820258254566 → script exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-verify-aws-account.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASS\|ok'
- [ ] Failure-mode: wrong account → exits 1 with expected/actual diff
  Verify: grep -qE 'wrong|different|mismatch|expected.*actual' tests/scripts/test-verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] Failure-mode: aws auth failure → exits non-zero
  Verify: grep -qE 'auth.failure|aws.error|nonzero' tests/scripts/test-verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] Failure-mode: aws absent → exits non-zero with clear error
  Verify: grep -qE 'aws.*missing|aws.*not.found|missing.*cli' tests/scripts/test-verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] Config integration: test verifies script reads review_telemetry.aws_account_id when key is present
  Verify: grep -q 'review_telemetry.aws_account_id' tests/scripts/test-verify-aws-account.sh
- [ ] Script reads expected account from dso-config.conf via read-config
  Verify: grep -q 'read-config.*review_telemetry.aws_account_id\|review_telemetry\.aws_account_id' plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
